notes:
The beta programme, and a GOAT Help fix.

- GOAT Help answers technical questions again: on paid plans every real question came back as "I couldn't put an answer together" because the model spent its whole answer budget thinking. Fixed on the server.
- Beta programme: an invited tester signs in with Google or Discord and the app comes up fully unlocked for the programme (a BETA badge shows until when). Sharing stays at GOAT Elite; the only sharing choice left is whether your name appears on reference laps.
- Feedback reaches us: the Feedback and Request buttons also send to GOAT when signed in, with a redacted copy of your logs and diagnostics when the box is ticked.
- Send logs uploads the redacted bundle straight to GOAT support when signed in; the zip-in-Downloads and email route remains when not.
